rounds.text: Forbes & Company Ltd is currently positioned at a critical inflection point where the market is ignoring a significant structural turnaround in performance. While long-term historical data shows decline [E8, E9], the company has successfully pivoted to achieve a 18% compounded sales growth and a 29% compounded profit growth over the last three years [E10, E14]. This recent performance trajectory significantly outpaces the sector median profit growth of 17.0% and sales growth of 13.0% [E65, E66]. Investors are currently able to acquire this growth at a valuation of only 1.80x book value [E2], which is a modest premium for a company demonstrating such a strong recent recovery. Conceded: [E1, E4, E5, E6, E7, E11, E13, E15, E49, E59, E60]. The current market capitalisation of ₹ 360 Cr [E3] fails to account for the momentum established in the most recent three-year period, suggesting that the market is overly fixated on legacy metrics rather than the company's demonstrated ability to outperform its sector peers [E10, E14, E65, E66].
